tools.name: check_domains
tools.description: Check whether domain names are actually available to register, using live registry (RDAP) data. Use this when suggesting domain names (verify availability before presenting them, never assume a name is unregistered) or when the user asks whether specific domains are available. Accepts up to 50 fully-qualified domains (e.g. 'brewlog.app'). Returns availability, the registrar for taken domains, a 0-100 brandability score, an estimated resale value, the price in USD (price_usd for term_years, quote it rather than estimating; price_source 'checkout' is the expected charge at buy_url, confirmed before payment), and buy_url, the domhaul checkout page where the user can purchase the domain. If too few names are available, generate more candidates and call again.

domains.description: Fully-qualified domain names to check, e.g. ['brewlog.app', 'getbrewlog.com']. Max 50.

tools.name: get_tld_prices
tools.description: Get registrar retail first-year price estimates in USD for top-level domains (.com, .io, .app, .dev, .ai, …). Use this when the user is comparing TLD options, e.g. 'should I get the .com or the .io?'. For the exact purchase price of a specific domain, use check_domains instead.

tlds.description: TLDs to price, with or without the leading dot, e.g. ['com', '.io', 'app']
